title: Proper-boundary cohomology from closed-boundary restriction
statement: Under the proper-boundary hypotheses, if the intrinsic extension by zero restricts to zero on the base change of the closed boundary, then every positive right-derived global-section object vanishes.

source.place: Tags 09AG, 09C9 and 098H, after the closed-boundary restriction step.

proof.text: Use finite-level proper base change and the closed-restriction hypothesis to kill the derived direct image on the closed boundary.
Use the open-closed exact sequence, specialization-zero evaluation, and weakly contractible affine evaluation to identify the positive cohomology with zero.

lean.statement: theorem proEtale_proper_boundary_cohomology_of_closed_restriction_zero (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (hR : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S), φ.FaithfullyFlat → φ.WeaklyEtale → ∃ r : S →+* R, r.comp φ = RingHom.id R) {Z E P U : Scheme.{u}} (z : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [IsClosedImmersion z] (e : E ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [IsOpenImmersion e] [QuasiCompact e] (hcomplement : Set.range e = (Set.range z)ᶜ) (hspecializes : ∀ x : Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ∃ t : Z, Specializes x (z t)) (p : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [IsProper p] (h : U ⟶ pullback p e) [IsOpenImmersion h] (hclosed : IsClosed (Set.range h)) [QuasiCompact (h ≫ pullback.fst p e)] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] [HasInjectiveResolutions (proEtaleRingModules P (proEtaleConstantRing P A))] (J : proEtaleRingModules U (proEtaleConstantRing U A)) [Injective J] (hzero : IsZero ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A (pullback.snd z p)).obj ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero (h ≫ pullback.fst p e) A).obj J))) (hetale : ∃ J₀ : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)), Nonempty ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence U A).functor.obj ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) U).obj J₀) ≅ J)) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : IsZero (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology P) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (proEtaleConstantRing P A)) ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (ProEt.topology P) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙ (CategoryTheory.evaluation P.ProEtᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 P)))).rightDerived q).obj ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero (h ≫ pullback.fst p e) A).obj J))
